text:
marc: Dropped a quick prototype for the billing table. Main questions: where should the invoice CTAs live and where does the scope selector feel most discoverable? Figma link in the thread.

neha: My vote: put scope chip next to the date picker. Users think scope is a date-like filter. Persist selection in the URL so a link shares the same view.

ayana: Agree on moving scope. For invoice CTAs, I prefer a small visible download button per month row + a consolidated "Download all" in the header when scope=org. That reduces hunting.

luca: Small caution: per-row CTAs stack vertically and bloat height. Can we collapse older months by default? Keep current month expanded.

marc: Collapsing months is fine. If we do per-row CTA it should be icon+text: "Download (PDF)" to avoid ambiguity. Also include Export CSV in the expanded area.

a11y-bot: Accessibility notes: avoid hover-only controls. Download buttons must be keyboard reachable; add aria-labels like "Download March 2026 invoice (PDF)". Contrast check: current icon color fails on light gray backgrounds.

neha: Good point. Also microcopy: change column header from "Tokens" to "Compute tokens (est.)" and add a short helper: "Estimate based on model usage; final billed amount may vary."

ayana: On token visibility: show $ estimates only inside expanded detail or in exports, not in the compact table. Keeps primary table scannable.

luca: For mobile, make the hit target 44px for the chevron and download button. The download should kick off via invoiceDownloadUrl returned in the table API to avoid extra fetches.

marc: Dev note accepted: invoiceDownloadUrl in the row payload. Also we'll add a small chevron to reveal a per-row detail panel with token breakdown and Export CSV.

a11y-bot: Popover behavior: open on Enter/Space when focused, close on ESC, restore focus to the triggering element. Use role="dialog" with aria-modal="false" for the slide-over.

neha: Action items: move scope chip to header near date, persist in URL; implement per-row download + consolidated header download when scope=org; collapse older months by default; update microcopy to include "Compute tokens (est.)"; ensure invoiceDownloadUrl is in API; run contrast audit.

marc: I'll update Figma and the PRD. Ping me when contrast fixes and keyboard flow are ready. Thanks! :thumbsup:
